items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet suffered non-contact knee injury late in TNF win over Patriots, carted off, ruled out for game; coach Ben Johnson said it 'didn't look very good,' more tests Friday. Rapoport: appear to have lost him.
items.why: Non-contact knee, carted, coach pessimistic, tests pending
items.implication: Loveland and depth TEs (Roush) elevated for snaps/routes/targets in high-volume Bears offense
items.opportunity: Increased TE snaps/routes for Loveland post-Kmet absence

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left Thursday practice early with calf injury, listed limited. Rapoport: believed minor/not significant; availability for Week 7 @ LV uncertain, Friday update expected. Adams already on IR.
items.why: Calf issue mid-practice, tests indicate minor per sources
items.implication: If out/limited, targets redistribute to TEs/Higbee/Atwell/Mumpfield; if in, massive volume post-Adams
items.opportunity: Potential 25+ target share if plays; reverse if OUT

items.text: Multiple teams open to potential trade for Colts RB Jonathan Taylor; unclear if Colts ready to unload before deadline. Rapoport notes Colts decision pending.
items.implication: ROS value volatile; handcuff/backup implications if moved
items.opportunity: Potential new landing spot role change

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially DNP second straight day with hamstring injury.
items.implication: Elevates Worthy/others if misses; monitor Friday status
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy role expansion if Rice out

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed facility access for meetings/lifting/medical/non-football activities. MarShawn Lloyd 49th and Kaleb Johnson 53rd in EPA/rush (54 qualifiers); OL mess contributing. Discussed Jacobs long-term/ROS on Top-150 show.
items.why: Facility access positive sign; backups inefficient EPA
items.implication: Jacobs ROS rebound likely once cleared; fade Lloyd/Johnson short-term
items.opportunity: Jacobs snap/carry share return; poor backup efficiency supports

items.text: Saquon Barkley 'in line' to play vs DAL MNF (RB15 rank); very efficient in two full games played. Dallas top fantasy RB matchup.
Terrance Ferguson (eligible IR next week) not expected ready, recovery 'will take some time' (Schefter). Biggest Adams beneficiary delayed; Rams only answer now 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Ferguson delay + Adams IR leaves Puka as primary
items.implication: Puka massive target/opportunity spike if healthy; TEs secondary
items.opportunity: 25 tgt/game projection for Nacua; Higbee/Parkinson volume

items.text: Fact: Ashton Jeanty inefficient (<3 YPC 4/5 games), lowest snaps recent, Mike Washington season-high 33% snaps/near equal rushes—role expansion possible. Bo Nix 5.4 aDOT (no viable Broncos WRs). C.J. Stroud hot (6th fantasy QB last 3 wks). Coker out-targeting/scoring McMillan.
items.why: Snap/YPC trends for Jeanty; scheme aDOT for Nix
items.implication: Monitor Jeanty split; fade Broncos pass-catchers; stream Stroud
items.opportunity: Washington carries up if Jeanty limited; Coker > McMillan targets

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): back in real role, 33% target share, 97% routes Week 6 despite 3 drops/3 catches; Bears good yardage spot. Buying the usage.
Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL (WR11 elite volume), Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6 Lions D gift to pass catchers), Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9 big workload friendly matchup). Also Hubbard vs TB, Irving @ CAR.
items.why: Usage + matchups (Lions D soft, volume backs)
items.implication: Strong starts; Kraft TE upside, Warren/Hubbard/Irving RB2+
items.opportunity: Routes/targets for Smith/Kraft; carries/snaps for RBs

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (WR32 nasty matchup), Josh Downs @ MIN (WR41 target-share/low-scoring issues), Travis Kelce @ SEA (TE9 tough D), Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18 workload questions post-layoff). Also Skattebo.
items.opportunity: Limited for these; reverse for backups if Jacobs limited

items.text: Thorman Snaps & Pace: GB@DET highest total/fantasy-friendliest (Packers faster PROE/pass rate, Lions top EPA/offense + allow most; high combined snaps/points). LAR@LV up-pace (Rams solid underlying, Raiders funnel). TB@CAR tempo up. Slow: SF@ATL, MIA@NYJ, IND@MIN.
items.implication: Prioritize GB/DET/LAR stack volume; avoid slog games for volume plays
items.opportunity: High snap environments for Love/Gibbs/St. Brown/Nacua/etc.

items.text: JJ McCarthy YPT when throwing to Justin Jefferson only 5.7 (vs Mullens 10.8, Cousins 10.5, Darnold 10.0, Wentz 9.9). Different scheme/coaches/small sample but hard to ignore; room for improvement.
items.implication: Jefferson efficiency concern if McCarthy starts long-term; monitor
items.opportunity: Target volume still high but YAC/YPT suppressed

items.text: Bears Week 10 bye then close vs Saints(27th Y/P), Lions(24), Jags(26), Dolphins(21), Bills(25), Packers(3), Lions(24). Early season high-scoring or backup/weather limited.
items.implication: ROS boost for Bears skill players (Williams/Swift/Odunze/Loveland)
